g16-c01-users-reference-excluded-from-c0.rationale: The public Users Reference identifies itself as G16 Rev. C.01 and cannot be silently promoted into the C.02 delta corpus.

g16-c02-platform-list.title: Gaussian 16 Available Binary Versions for Rev. C.01 and C.02

limitations: C.02 release materials are a delta and do not make the C.01 public user reference version-matched C.02 documentation.
No private manual, installer, binary, example, basis payload, or checkpoint is stored.
Selector kind json-pointer is retained; no virtual selector body bytes are introduced by migration.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

g16-c02-no-complete-reference.description: The public C.02 delta does not provide a complete version-matched C.02 keyword, IOp, input, output, or utility corpus.

g16-c02-platform-profile.statement: Gaussian 16 Rev. C.02 platform statements require the bounded C.02 platform-list source and remain separate from C.01 syntax.

g16-c02-release-delta.statement: Gaussian 16 Rev. C.02 release and platform statements require a C.02-specific provider input and do not re-version the C.01 reference.
